definitions.explanation: The act of washing clothes or other fabric items. Also refers to the clothes themselves that need to be washed or have been washed.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}がいいから{洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}を{外|そと}に{干|ほ}そう。
examples.english: The weather is nice, so let's hang the laundry outside to dry.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{洗濯機|せんたくき}を{回|まわ}してから{仕事|しごと}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: Every morning I run the washing machine before going to work.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common household vocabulary words. Used with する to form the verb "to do laundry" ({洗濯|せんたく}する). The kanji {濯|たく} is rarely seen outside this word.

Be careful not to confuse with the homophone {選択|せんたく} (selection, choice), which uses different kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗濯|せんたく}する: to do laundry
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}: laundry (items to be washed or drying)
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}: washing machine
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}を{干|ほ}す: to hang laundry to dry
- {洗濯|せんたく}{物|もの}を{取|と}り{込|こ}む: to bring in the laundry
